question: Which of the following Articles was amended in the Constitution (Fifth Amendment Act), 1955?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 3**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution (Fifth Amendment) Act, 1955 amended several articles of the Indian Constitution.
 
• **One significant change was the amendment to Article 3.**
 
• It d**eals with the procedure for the formation of new states **and alteration of areas, boundaries, or names of existing states.
 
• The amendment clarified and reinforced the process by which the Parliament could enact changes concerning the states.
 
• It made it explicit that the President of India could initiate the process of reorganization, and the Parliament would then have the final say.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 17: Abolition of Untouchability**

 
 
• **​A**bolishes the practice of untouchability, making it illegal in India.
 
• It states that the enforcement of any disability arising out of untouchability is a punishable offense under the law.
 
• The article promotes social equality by ensuring that all individuals have the right to equality before the law, irrespective of caste.
 
 
 
• **Article 34: Restriction on Rights Conferred by Part III While Martial Law is in Force**
 
 
• **​A**llows the Parliament to restrict the rights conferred by Part III (Fundamental Rights) of the Constitution during the enforcement of martial law in any area.
 
 
 
• **Article 45: Provision for Early Childhood Care and Education**
 
 
• **​D**irects the state to provide for early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years.
 
• Emphasizes the importance of early childhood education in the holistic development of children,
 
 
• addressing their physical, mental, and social needs.
 
 
 
 

e0:T
